title: Clamp into an inclusive interval
summary: Return a natural number constrained to an inclusive lower and upper bound.
preconditions: lower is less than or equal to upper
postconditions: result is greater than or equal to lower
result is less than or equal to upper
invariants: a value already inside the interval is unchanged
non_goals: behavior for an interval whose lower bound exceeds its upper bound
ambiguity_notes: resolved: both interval endpoints are inclusive
